title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: On Monday a student tells your assistant their email address. On Friday they start a new session and your team has added no saving or loading code. The assistant does not know the address. Why?

options.text: The model keeps only a week of conversations, and Friday was too late
The context window was too small to hold Monday's whole conversation
The context ended with Monday's session, and nothing saved it for Friday
The model stored the address but cannot read it back without a tool

items.stem: An agent starts with 1,000 tokens of context. Each model output is 200 tokens and each tool result is 500 tokens. It makes three model calls: a tool request, a second tool request, then the final answer. Each call sends the whole history so far. How many tokens does it send in total across the three calls?
Your assistant must answer from a 400-page CNC router manual that is far too long to include in every call. Which design fits best?

options.text: Search the manual per question and put only the best few chunks in
Paste the whole manual into the system prompt on a larger model
Summarise the manual once into one line and rely on that line
Ask the model to recall the manual from what it learned in training

items.stem: In one or two sentences: an agent has been planning a long booking task and its context is nearly full. How can writing notes help, and where must the notes be kept?
Which fact about a student should your assistant check with a live tool call on each request, rather than rely on a saved note from an earlier session?

options.text: Which of the machines they have already been trained to use
Which of two printers is free at 4 pm on Thursday
Which email address they asked to be sent reminders at
Which of the makerspace's three sites is closest to them
